responsibility: This definition file is the master declarative description of GCC’s optimization pipeline. Using NEXT_PASS/INSERT_PASSES_AFTER/PUSH_INSERT_PASSES_WITHIN macros, it lists the ordered lowering, IPA, GIMPLE, and RTL passes and nested subpass groups that make up the compiler’s standard pass tree. It is the source from which pass-manager construction code and per-instance pass fields are generated.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/passes.cc, which executes and manages passes at runtime, this .def file is the declarative specification of the ordered pass tree and nesting structure used to construct GCC's optimization pipeline.
